name: caprigo
description: Caprigo - local-first AI agents. Caprigo Core runtime, web UI, Caprigo CLI.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @caprigo/shared && npm run build -w @caprigo/ollama-client && npm run build -w @caprigo/chat-backend && npm run build -w @caprigo/user-skills-loader && npm run build -w @caprigo/agent && npm run build -w @caprigo/gateway && npm run build -w @caprigo/cli
scripts.launch: npm run build && npm run build:web && npm run start
